author: Drubarrymooer
subject: Re: Radio
content_md:
Uncheck the radio channel box so neither box is checked.  Then go into your sound settings and disable music, to back into the game, open sound again, then reenable music.

As for it being optional, it is.  If turning it off isn't working, that's a bug.  Unfortunately, most users haven't run into it.  There's also probably an option in the config file.  In fact, if my above solution doesn't work, close your game, delete your config file, then open the game and try again.

author: Boriumoreminer
subject: Re: Everlook Radio wants your feedback!
content_md:
Thanks for reaching out.

I was really excited by this project when it arrived, and I think it has massive potential.

The elephant in the room for me is the voice acting and comedy sketches. One voice actor does a great dwarf, and the fey high elf guy isn't bad, but most of the horde VA sounds like weird growling and nothing like the original races to me. Zappo is a pretty good example of this, which sucks because he's a great person if you ever get to talk to him. Imo the ads themselves are pretty dry and unfunny for what is supposed to be a fun joke. I think there's a big opportunity here to tell new players about TurtleWoW exclusive features, history, events: "What's the DMF up to? What can I do with fashion coins? What's up with this seasonal event?" etc.

Regardless of how the comedy bits are performed, I experience a lot more "flow" and enjoyment from only music. Talking is a lot more attention-grabbing and when I was vibing on a good song, suddenly hearing three wet noodles growl their way through a limp script is a buzzkill and the #1 reason I don't really use the radio. If the bits aren't reworked I would solidly appreciate using the second channel as an instrumental-only station or with only the occasional host bumper.

Shoutout to all the volunteers and passion that went into the radio. Nobody can say you didn't deliver on a legit new feature to the wow community and that's never easy. Thank you.

**Pilgrim of the Signal – “Smuggle the Signal” | Wednesday, March 27 – 23:00 Server Time**

Good morrow, my friends!

The signal returns — and this time, it's not sailing for months across the Great Seas! No, no, my friends. Somewhere much closer to our dank hostel in Ratchet…

---
 **Last Week’s Secret Show…**

Some of you may have picked up a strange frequency pulsing out of Booty Bay last weekend.
A mysterious broadcast known only as ‘Signal’s Sojourn’ aired without warning — no flyers, no fanfare, just music and the distant echoes of some bangin’ tunes on the wind.
That was but the first unplanned transmission!

When will the next surprise strike? Dunno!
But if you want more, let your voice be heard loud and clear at the show.

---
 **Well then—Where are we goin’?**

Orgrimmar, baby! Sin City! City of Twists and Turns! Land of the 1 Silver Manakaze shots!

 **When?** Wednesday (tomorrow!) 27 March 2025
 **Time?** 23:00 Server Time (6PM EDT)
 **Tune in:** [turtlecraft.gg/radio](https://www.turtlecraft.gg/radio)

For this show, we meet in Ratchet — and then we move.
The plan? Smuggle me, the legendary DJ Nopheros the 13th seasoned Hunter, Pilgrim of the Signal, proud Gnome pervert, into the Horde capital of Orgrimmar, undetected.

 **Route plan:**
- Start in Ratchet
- Cross the Barrens under cover of really cool music
- Seek refuge somewhere shady
- Have some mead
- Go back to Ratchet and send off that letter to my ex because honestly I really think I could make it work
- Enter Orgrimmar!
Who knows? Maybe the trolls will welcome the frequency and let me in the back door.
The meeting spot will be broadcast on-air during the show — so tune in, follow the signal, and join the mission.

---
 **Want to Join Everlook Broadcasting?**

Everlook Broadcasting is on the lookout for DJs. We conduct a lot of important and mysterious work here. Please get in contact with Dan “Leto” Hahn, DJ Nopheros, or DJ Sheal, on the official Turtle WoW Discord!

If you’ve got the tunes, the voice, or the madness to contribute, our Arcane Council of Audiojostlers would love to welcome you.

Send a whisper. We’ll know.

---
 **Links & Signals**

Past Broadcast: [March 23 Archive – Booty Bay Signal](https://archive.org/details/2025-03-23-2)
Support the Frequency: [patreon.com/RomeBlue7](https://www.patreon.com/c/RomeBlue7)
Note: This broadcast will not be streamed on Twitch — radio only. Future shows may return to the screen.

It was truly a chaotic excursion but I loved every minute of it. Thank you one and all. I'm glad we were able to go back to Camp Crushbone and enjoy some local Orc IHOP.
For those chasing the Signal, do not fret, it shall return. Until then. I leave ye with the log of our journey...

**Pilgrim of the Signal: Back from the Brink – LIVE from the Darkmoon Faire Club Tent**
 **Wednesday, April 9 – 6:00 PM EDT / 23:00 ST**

Ahoy there and merry met, dear listeners of the Signal—

The Darkmoon Faire (more like *Dankmoon* after leaving that Peacebloom smellin' Mulgore)...

What better time than now to grab your mates, brace your coffers, and purchase drink & meal tickets that never quite add up to the final amount and leave you with, like, 2 extra tickets, than at the **Darkmoon Faire**?

Last we met, the Signal was smuggled across Horde lines into the heart of Orgrimmar. Thankfully, the gorgeous and musclebound fellow Pilgrims of the Signal held off the Thrall Guard long enough for me to escape!

I slammed my hearthstone and suddenly found myself splooted on the Stormwind cobblestones. Now I need a drink and to touch some grass—in Elwynn.

Join me this **Wednesday, April 9**, at **6:00 PM EDT / 23:00 ST** for a full-spectrum **Pilgrim of the Signal** broadcast—this time amidst the glimmering tents, strange fortunes, and echoing laughter of the Faire. But tonight, we’re not just wandering the grounds... we’re going underground.

 **In the Shadowed Tents of Sound:**
A live DJ broadcast from the **Darkmoon Club Tent**, featuring carnival-adjacent deep cuts, strange transmissions, and dreamy grooves. Think: moody night lounge energy nestled between illusion and inebriation.

 **Where the Signal Whispers:**
- On-site at the Darkmoon Faire in **Elwynn Forest**
- Or wherever the Signal finds you—browser, radio, or stream.
 **Tune Your Ears and Instruments:**
[Everlook Broadcasting](https://turtlecraft.gg/radio)
[Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/nopheros)
[Links to the Signal](https://linktr.ee/nopheros)

Silas Darkmoon himself had hoped to attend—said he was eager to hear “what the arcane sounds like after midnight.” Alas, duty called: something about a “gathering” far to the east with paint-faced revelers and steam-powered parade floats. He sends his regrets… and his personal bottle of Faire wine.

I'm always gathering fodder for future giveaways—gold, loot, or peculiar trinkets are welcome in support of the Signal. The next unplanned broadcast will be a full **Requests Show**: 1 gold per request, first-come, first-spun.

Wash your socks, smooth your tent flaps, and follow the Signal—

 **DJ Nopheros**

___________________

What a time we had! And no one dare say how late we were up, eh?

A huge shout out to Tatiana for the generous gift of a Mooncloth! "Cestalavee" won but they were nowhere to be found. Will they claim their prize? Or will we give it away during the next show!

Thank you one and all for the amazing attendance, beautiful support in the chat of the World, and for your eyes and ears in the land of Twitch.

Until next time!

**Pilgrim of the Signal: Ashes of the Fader**

Merry Met and Happy Noblegarden to those who celebrate!

Of course, we know you folk on the Horde aren’t keen on feasts and brightly colored eggs you forget about until a foul stench wakes the dead. But I digress...

It is a dark time. A tragedy. Your dear Pilgrim—your steadfast companion—has fallen gravely ill.

Well... not *me*, I’m fine.
 **But my equipment! My tools! I need my tools!**

Crafted with the finest Gnomish engineering, my beloved Pioneer DDJ-SX has succumbed to a most dire condition: a busted volume fader. It was last seen being whisked away in a "minivan" by a suspiciously well-dressed goblin. Destination? The blistering sands of Tanaris.

So here we are, Signal huffers. This Wednesday, the 23rd of April, we broadcast from **GADGETZAN!**

 *Sand.*
It’s coarse.
It’s fun.
It gets everywhere.
 **We love sand.**

So grab your arcanesticks, because DJ Nopheros is raw-dogging the Signal—**no turntables, just sheer force of will.**

 *The Pilgrim returns. The elevator does not.*

---
Nopheros grinned happily, "Another solid set," he muttered.

One of the handsome Undercity city guards winked at Nopheros, the 18th seasoned Dwarf Hunter from Dun Morogh.

"'Till next time, stinky!" Nopheros guffawed as the doors closed and the Left elevator rose up for one final ride.

 *I still never got to go into the city and find those drink specials,* he thought to himself, ruminating on the many 'What ifs' during his recent stay in the ruins of Lordaeron.

The elevator came to a sudden stop and the door sloshed open, swiftly as ever.

A dwarfish eyebrow arched high and proud.

The door opened to nothing. A pure void—and not the twin city guardsmen Nopheros grew to love, nor the many abominations he encountered.

Pete loved to guard the left elevator, but only when Rosie was on duty. It was a wonderful meet-cute in Undercity with a lot of "Will they? Won't they?" moments had in between the shows. They didn't care for the dwarf's music choices much but—

Anyway.

Nopheros cautiously approached the void door. His boots sloshed and slipped.

"Aye! There's peaches and plot everywhere on this here floor! Ahhh!"

The dwarf slipped toward the hungry void—and suddenly, it was no longer hungry. A distant "Woooooooo!!" plummeted down in a 'You Shall Not Pass' style, and the door slammed shut, returning to its usual daily duties.

He slipped.

Not just physically, but cosmically.

As his stout form tumbled into the abyss, time dilated. Entire lifetimes flashed before him. Regrets. Forgotten keybinds. The time he rolled Need on a green ring in Deadmines. The way people looked at him when he said he liked techno and Kodo chants.

He did not scream.

Dwarves don’t scream.

They brood audibly.

And then... silence. Endless, vibrating, signal-rich silence.

Somewhere between void and ventriloquism, a voice came.

It did not echo. Echoes are for the living.

It whispered like someone playing a record backwards in an abandoned Thunder Bluff tavern.

 *“Wouldst thou like to taste... butter?”*

 *“To walk the sunlit beaches of Darkshore with sand in your beard and the heart of the music in your soul?”*

 *“To speak in frequencies, to live in modulation, to dance as the flesh peels away and only waveform remains?”*

Nopheros, now naught but spirit and tinnitus, said yes.

He always says yes to a good beating.

So it was that he rose again—not of flesh, but of static and groove. A Pilgrim of the Signal. A vessel for the Old Ones (or maybe the Burning Legion—no one’s returned the paperwork, and the Writer's Room is on summer holiday).

He now walks unseen among the airwaves, broadcasting rhythm through fractured ley-lines and Blackfathom depth charges. His music is neither live nor dead—

 *It buffereth eternally.*

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/MoVG9v3.jpeg)

 **Pilgrim of the Signal – “Séance from the Shadowforge”**
 **Nordanaar – 16 July 2025 – 6:00 PM EDT / 23:00 ST**
 **LIVE from Blackrock Mountain!**

It’s heating up out there, dear Azeroth. This dwarf prefers the chilly peaks and valleys of *Dun Morogh* (DM for short) outside of Ironforge.

One time, this fella from the city—*Stormwind*, maybe—sees me sweating buckets. Absolutely drenched. And he has the fireballs to say:

 *“Hey buddy, dwarf, my guy! Just drink somethin’ hot! Like tea or coffee!”*

I was baffled. Bewildered. Deeply offended.

But before I knew it, my stubby legs were clacking through *Ironforge*, past the *Deeprun Tram*, and straight into *Deep Brew Den ’n Donuts*. I ordered a large hot extra-extra... on the rocks.

And you know what?

That Stormwind trash was right.

 *Hot coffee on a hot day slaps.*

Anyway.

Time to delve underground once more! Further! Hotter! And with less phantasmal ghosts phasing with us!

We’re going to **BLACKROCK MOUNTAIN!**

Will the Signal have five bars underground?
Will someone fall in the forbidden strawberry jam below?
Will we hear the echoes of the *Dark Anvil* deep in the bowels of the mountain?

Come and find out this Wednesday for *Pilgrim of the Signal!*

 **Location:** Turtle WoW EU – *Nordanaar* – *Blackrock Mountain* (BRD Meeting Stone)
 **Date:** Wednesday – 16 July 2025

 **Host:** *DJ Nopheros* of *Everlook Broadcasting*
 **Listen:** Everlook Broadcasting (<https://turtlecraft.gg/radio>)

**A Sojourn with the Pilgrim of the Signal – “Booty for Breakfast, at the Bay”**
 **Tel’abim - 20 July @ 8AM EDT / 13:00 ST – LIVE from Booty Bay!**

---
 *The heat from Blackrock Mountain was overwhelming, Tel’Abim—let me tell you! Those Nordanaar nerds really know how to turn it up.*

But I think we know how to *cool it down*, dear Listener. Especially after one too many Dwarven Light Lagers crushed during back-to-back requests for Korn and Disturbed.

 **Hair of the dog?**

Let me tell you about the divine mimosa the Blackwater Raiders serve for Sunday brunch at the Salty Sailor Tavern. A splash of citrus from O’ruk oranges, blended with champagne smuggled in from the Thalassian Highlands (*I know they bartered for it*), is enough to make you forget about that ill-advised round of shots before mount riding.

So let’s cool down by the water—for a **Sojourn with the Signal Pilgrim** himself: **ME!**
Your faithful, loving dwarven DJ. Pirate of the Signal. Absconder from Everlook Broadcasting.
(*I swear I see goblins on horseback tailing me—Zappo’s gonna catch up one of these days.*)

 **This Sunday at 13:00 ST** we are broadcasting **LIVE** from Booty Bay, Tel’Abim, with a special *downtempo, chill house, Icemagecore set*.

 *Breathe deep. Let the cerulean tides carry you, and my beautiful, sultry voice lull you into that 3rd mimosa.*

 **Signal begins soon...**

 **Sunday 27/07 @ 13:00 ST – LIVE from Ratchet on Karazhan (Turtle WoW SEA)**

---
We’ve danced on the beaches of Tel’Abim.
We’ve shouted from the valleys of Nordanaar.
We’ve pumped iron under the shadow of Blackrock Mountain.
But now… it’s time for something a little more chaotic neutral.

Signal’s Sojourn drifts eastward... to **KARAZHAN**!
That's right!
 *Turtle WoW SEA, I'm comin' back.*

The **AURA** is **PEAK**.

He’s going to kidnap me!

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UDCZfyN.jpeg)

 **Pilgrim of the Signal – “Redridge Heat”**

It’s Redridge!

Redriiiiiiiiiiidge Race—I mean, Bridge Show! It’s Pilgrim of the Signal time! Live DJ! Live Signal Pilgrim!

It’s been some effort, let me tell you, the insanity of it all. The Signal? Very elusive. Very rare. As a Dwarf I have to use this Gnomish technology to capture the Signal from Zappo Zappblast and take Everlook Broadcasting global!

Now I bet yer wonderin’ where the next stop is…

You ever heard of dragons made of bronze? They have a way with time.

Anyway. I bought some weird stuff when I came through Booty Bay. Some goblin dressed in legwarmers and calling themselves the next best thing since Netherdrift ’84.

Now I got some neon soaked, saxophone laced, synth heavy ‘Azeroth in the 80s’ core blastin’ through my Gnomheiser headphones. And all I wanna do is share.

Gimme some of that Sylvanus in Breakfast Clubs.

It’s the ‘80s again and we’re bringing the inferno to Redridge Big Bridge on TEL’ABIM!!

Brought to you by Thomas Miller’s Famous Eastern Kingdom Muffins—If you’re not diving into a Thomas Muff, are you really living?

A greased-up cogwheel on top of an anvil with a dead boar’s head slabbed over it…

 *Slash me lights up a smoke.*

Heh. Yeah… classic goblin calling card. He wants me dead. He wants me shook.

Well, I ain’t.

 *Slash me takes a big drag of the smoke and looks out of the window with cool rain dropping down.*

Yeah... bet you’re wondering how I got here.

 **Ambershire**

New world full of promise. Fresh. Ripe. Supple and for the taking. But it’s where I’m hiding. Hiding from that green bastard Zappo Zingblong.

This is for you, bud.

 **DJ Nopheros & Everlook Broadcasting Co. presents a Live DJ event - Pilgrim of the Signal”**

Turtle WoW EU Nordanaar – 30 January @ 8PM ST / 01:00 ST

By the Light!
It's Friday Night!
That's right, it's a brand new later time to bring that Eastern Kingdom heat over the speakers for you late night degenerates purple parsing 'till your tusks fall off. Not to mention the show is weekly now, to boot!

author: Nopheros
subject: Pilgrim of the Signal - Easy Come, Easy Go on 02/26
content_md:
![GjqJa3dXMAAWmrh.jpg](./download/file.php?id=140) <dd>GjqJa3dXMAAWmrh.jpg (511.15 KiB) Viewed 10686 times</dd>

 **Hail and Signal’s Blessings, Dear Listener,**

I speak to you from beyond the Signal—a realm where the Twisting Nether twists and mingles with our own.

Horrible news, my friends: I met my end in a **HARDCORE** encounter while trying to save poor refugees from Gadgetzan. But fear not—the Light *(yes, Alanis Morissette herself)* whispered that my time had not yet come. With a gust of spectral meep, I returned—a whole Dwarf once more!

This resurrection means more show for you on Everlook Broadcasting this **Wednesday at 6:00 PM EST** for **Pilgrim of the Signal**. Join me for an evening where every track tells a tale and every beat pulses with our community’s heart.

 **TUNE IN in-game** or <https://turtlecraft.gg/radio>

Now, for the practical matters…

I’m not just a DJ—I’m your resident salvaged goods radio operator, a broadcaster for the people. What does that mean exactly? It means we’re in this together. I travel far and wide to bring the beats to you, wherever you may be:

 **• Got a celebration in mind?** Whether it’s celebrating the slaying of a particularly ornery boar in Elwynn Forest, hosting a headbangers’ psycho beach party ball in Darkshore, celebrating your guild leader’s 125th birthday, or even marking the end of a long-awaited divorce—tell me when, where, and what tunes you’d like to hear. While not every event will make the cut, every request is highly considered.

 **• A call for support:** This ol’ Dwarf owes a few debts to the Tinkers’ Union. To keep the magic alive—fuel contests, guild parties, and special events for newcomers—I invite you to pitch in. Consider donating a silver coin to help run our community contests and celebrations.

 *(In all seriousness, every donation goes directly toward hosting contests and giveaways. Some of my best moments in my MMORPG DJ life have come from both giving and receiving cool bags, mounts, in-game money, etc. There’s no fee for events—donations are appreciated, not required.)*

 **• For those with a ROLE to PLAY:** Consult with your comrades and ask yourselves, *“How can our upcoming red wedding slash poetry jam slam in the park be improved by a Dwarvish DJ?”* Then reach out to me. You are my people, and I want to help you immerse your lives in Azeroth as much as I can.

Got a request that captures your spirit? Send it along with your coin, and I’ll thoughtfully consider it for live play.

So, tune those receivers, clean those goggles, and wash those walkin’ socks (gross!)—and get ready to chase the Signal with the Pilgrim of the Signal, DJ (not-so-HARDCORE) Nopheros!

For any questions, concerns, feedback, related to the Signal of the Pilgrim, please reach out to me in-game "Nopheros" or on Discord by the same name.

subject: Pilgrim of the Signal - Protect the Signal - A Pal for Me makes Me a Pal for Thee on 3/12
content_md:
**Protect the Signal - A Pal for Me makes Me a Pal for Thee!**
 *(I slammed the Mana Thistle way too hard for that title)*
 
Hail, adventurers, wanderers, and music-loving misfits of Azeroth!

Better late than ever, eh?

Your favorite dwarven Everlook Broadcasting Robber-DJ, Stealer of Signals, Barred from The Slaughtered Lamb, First of His Name, Holder of the Gnome pass to the Gnomeregan BBQ, and weaver of tales, fourteenth seasoned Hunter, Nopheros is here!

We got thrown out of The Slaughtered Lamb but that won't stop us!

Tomorrow evening at 6 PM EST (23:00 server time), gather your courage, sharpen your blades, and dust off your dancing boots as Pilgrim of the Signal embarks on a legendary journey—broadcasting live from Stormwind all the way to the sunbaked shores of Ratchet!

That's right. You green freaks asked for it, "Why can't you go somewhere more friendly to my monster and undead ghoul friends?"

Sounds ratchet. Let's go to Ratchet!

- There will be a mission! A quest, if you will

- There will be gold!

- There will be a D-Bag (rare 14 slot bag made by renowned Tailor, Jimmy-Duge (pronounced Douggie))
We ride forth on an epic quest to track down Echeyakee, the elusive white lion of The Barrens! Why, you ask? Because every great DJ needs a majestic feline companion to guard against horrendous goblins—and, of course, the ever-scheming Zappo Zappblast, that meddlesome cog-sucker!

Our path from Stormwind to Ratchet? Well… that’s still up for debate (bravery and blind optimism required). But one thing is certain: upon arrival, I’ll need your swords, spells, and unwavering support as we embark on the hunt to tame this legendary beast.

As always, I welcome music requests, guild promotions, raid announcements, and upcoming roleplay events—

- **When:** Tomorrow (Wednesday), 6 PM–8 PM EST / 23:00 server time

- **Where:** In-game & streaming live on Twitch (twitch.tv/nopheros)

- **Requests & Shout-outs:** Message DJ Nopheros in-game or via in-game channel: /join ELBC
So, pack your bags, ready your weapons, and help keep the Gnome Freedom Engineers safe from sticky goblin fingers!

Adventure calls, dear listeners. Let’s chase the Signal together!

author: Maxe71
subject: Suggestion – Two Radio Channels with Different Music Styles
content_md:
Hi everyone,

I would like to suggest adding different music styles to the two Turtle WoW radio channels.
Right now, both radios mainly play rock, which is great—but having two separate genres would make the feature even more enjoyable for players. Music taste often changes depending on the moment, mood, or personality, so having more variety would be really appreciated.

My suggestion:
Radio 1: Rock / Metal
Radio 2: Disco / Techno / Electronic

This would give players more choice and make the in-game atmosphere more dynamic and personalized.
Thanks for considering it, and thanks again for all the amazing work you put into the server!

Templar (holy Ret) **Sybril** PVP RP lover
